0022600203.text: The Lakers (9-2, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West) arrive on a five-game winning streak, with an 8-2 record over their last ten and a 4-1 road record, while the Atlanta Hawks (7-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) are on a four-game winning streak and are 6-4 over their last ten. Los Angeles is without Quentin Grimes (out, finger) and Austin Reaves (day-to-day, illness, game-time decision), and Atlanta is missing Asa Newell (out, toe), Henri Veesaar (out, knee), Keshon Gilbert (out, knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (out, foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Lakers winning the most recent meeting 141-116 in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026.
